title: 第1811章 我都可以配合你第1810章 始界
slug: 穿书女频大婚当日被女主杀死
content_zh:
澹台凰道：“之前我说送你一桩造化与长生印有关，其实也是想要为自己谋一桩造化，我想进入始界尝试一下心中的猜测。”
叶凌天看着澹台凰：“你应该知道，我身上并无长生印......”
在他看来，澹台凰要谋造化，估计需要齐聚完整的长生印，但是他身上并无长生印。
不过按照系统所言，他的长生印虽然用于了抽奖，但从某种程度上来说，长生印的力量，其实也会留在他身上。
说到这里，他又想到了那最后一块长生印，到现在为止，那东西依旧一点信息都没有，不知被谁取走了。
真希望能够早一点找到那个东西，到时候直接让系统给一个无敌之法，横扫八方。
澹台凰道：“你身上有长生印的力量即可，若你身上没有那种力量，我也很难在远处通过这块长生印感知到你的情况。”
她自然知道叶凌天身上没有长生印，但对方身上有长生印的力量，这就足够了。
“行吧！”
叶凌天也没有多言。
澹台凰有何想法，他暂时也不知道，到时候让对方实践一下就行。
澹台凰将长生印收回眉心，她轻轻挥手，星辰飞舟化作残芒，向着星空深处飞去......
三天后。
澹台凰带着叶凌天进入星空深处，这里齐聚着数万颗星辰、每一颗星辰都按特殊规律排列，闪烁着九彩神光。
而在一众星辰最中央的区域，则是有一颗更为巨大的星辰，这颗星辰呈现蔚蓝色，充斥着磅礴的生机。
“嗯？这是......”
叶凌天看到这颗星辰的时候，不禁一怔，下意识想到了地球，不过这颗星辰，并非是地球。
澹台凰道：“这就是始界！”
她拉着叶凌天的手，直接飞身冲向始界。
没过多久。

两人进入始界。
地面之上，有山川、河流、湖泊、森林、草原等等，生命力无比磅礴。
四面八方的天地灵气、道韵之力也极为浓郁，比之上苍界的还要浓郁几分。
而在此界之中，更有一些城池，里面齐聚着诸多生灵族群，不过这里面的生灵，修为都不怎么高，连个道主都没有。
澹台凰道：“始界的灵气、道韵都很浓郁，但这里被创世主布置过，里面的生灵皆可拥有漫长的寿元，但他们却很难提升修为，或许创世主此举的本意，是想让始界生灵免于争斗。”
说着，她拉着叶凌天，缩地成寸，向着远处横跨而去。
半个时辰后。
澹台凰带着叶凌天来到始界最中央的地带。
这里没有其余的生灵，只有耀眼的七彩之光，宛若一片梦幻的天地，里面蕴藏着混沌、鸿蒙、光阴、太初、生死等等道则之力，每一种道则之力，皆浓郁无比。
其中，更是有创世之力！
随着靠近这里，叶凌天发现体内的创世图有一些异动，弥漫出一股创世仙力。
在这片梦幻天地之中，伫立着一座巨大的白色祭坛，祭坛古老，神秘无比，密布封禁。
content_en:
Tantaihuang said: "I said before that I would give you a good fortune related to the Immortality Seal, but actually I wanted to find a good fortune for myself. I want to enter the Beginning Realm to try out my guess."
Ye Lingtian looked at Tantai Huang: "You should know that I don't have the Immortality Mark on my body..."
In his opinion, if Tantaihuang wants to achieve good fortune, he probably needs to gather the complete Immortality Seal, but he does not have the Immortality Seal on his body.
However, according to the system, although his Immortality Seal was used for the lottery, to a certain extent, the power of the Immortality Seal would actually remain with him.
Having said this, he thought of the last longevity seal again. So far, there is still no information about that thing. I don't know who took it away.
I really hope that I can find that thing earlier, and then let the system give me an invincible method to sweep across all directions.
Tantaihuang said: "As long as you have the power of the Immortality Seal on your body, if you don't have that kind of power, it will be difficult for me to sense your situation from a distance through this Immortality Seal."
She naturally knew that Ye Lingtian did not have the Immortality Seal on his body, but the other party had the power of the Immortality Seal on his body, and that was enough.
"Okay!"
Ye Lingtian didn't say much.
He didn't know what Tantai Huang had in mind for the time being. He would just let the other party put it into practice when the time comes.
Tantai Huang put the Immortality Seal back between her eyebrows, waved her hand gently, and the star flying boat turned into residual light and flew towards the depths of the starry sky...
Three days later.
Tantaihuang took Ye Lingtian into the depths of the starry sky, where tens of thousands of stars gathered, each of them arranged according to special rules, shining with nine-colored divine light.
And in the center of the stars, there is an even bigger star. This star is blue and full of majestic vitality.
"Huh? This is..."
When Ye Lingtian saw this star, he couldn't help but be startled and subconsciously thought of the earth, but this star was not the earth.
Tantai Huang said: "This is the beginning of the world!"
She took Ye Lingtian's hand and flew directly towards the beginning.
It didn't take long.
The two entered the beginning realm.
Above the ground, there are mountains, rivers, lakes, forests, grasslands, etc., and their vitality is extremely majestic.
The spiritual energy of heaven and earth and the power of Tao Yun in all directions are also extremely rich, a bit richer than those in the Heaven Realm.
In this world, there are some cities where many groups of living beings gather, but the living beings here are not very high in cultivation, not even a Taoist master.
Tantai Huang said: "The spiritual energy and Taoist charm of the Beginning Realm are very strong, but this place has been arranged by the Creator. The creatures inside can have a long life, but it is difficult for them to improve their cultivation. Perhaps the original intention of the Creator is to prevent the creatures of the Beginning Realm from fighting."
As she said that, she pulled Ye Lingtian, shrunk to an inch, and crossed into the distance.
Half an hour later.
Tantaihuang took Ye Lingtian to the center of the Shijie.
There are no other living things here, only dazzling seven-colored light, like a dreamy world, which contains the power of principles of chaos, Hongmeng, time, Taichu, life and death, etc., and each power of Tao is extremely rich.
Among them, there is even more power to create the world!
As he got closer to this place, Ye Lingtian noticed that there were some strange movements in the Creation Diagram in his body, and a sense of Creation Immortal Power filled the air.
In this dreamy world, stands a huge white altar. The altar is ancient, mysterious, and tightly sealed.
